chunks: "The limit of intercepting is a day's short journey; then when it reaches four farsakhs, it is transportation."

key_terms.التَّلَقِّي: intercepting incoming traders before they reach the market
key_terms.جَلْبٌ: transporting or bringing goods to market
key_terms.رَوْحَةٌ: a short journey or travel span used here as a measure
key_terms.فَرَاسِخَ: farsakhs, a unit of travel distance

ai.seo_question: What is the legal limit for intercepting trade goods before it is considered ordinary transport?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal measure for when meeting traders outside the market is considered prohibited intercepting and when it is instead treated as ordinary transport or bringing goods. It establishes a distance-based distinction relevant to commercial dealings in fiqh.
